hints.title: Which days are still waiting?
hints.body: When you reach a warm day, it answers several earlier days at once. Which earlier days are still unresolved, and how can you find them quickly?

hints.title: Keep unresolved days on a stack
hints.body: Push the index of each day whose answer is not known yet. Keep the corresponding temperatures decreasing from bottom to top.

hints.title: Pop when the answer arrives
hints.body: While the stack is non-empty and the current temperature is greater than the temperature at the top index, pop that index and record the distance. Then push the current index.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
answer = array of zeros with the same length as temperatures
stack = empty
for index from 0 to length(temperatures) - 1:
    while stack is not empty and temperatures[index] > temperatures[stack.top]:
        earlier = stack.pop()
        answer[earlier] = index - earlier
    stack.push(index)
return answer
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution. Equal temperatures must stay on the stack.
